sentences.en: Do not resort to the sword but appeal to reason.
sentences.zh: 1. 不要诉诸武力，而应诉诸理智。

sentences.en: "Practising sword throwing?" "It just slipped out of my hands."
sentences.zh: 2. “练习扔剑吗？”“它只是从我手中滑落了。”

sentences.en: He who wounds by the sword, dies by the sword.
sentences.zh: 3. 凡是用刀剑伤害他人者，必会死于刀剑之下。

senses.zh: 剑，刀,武力，战争,兵权，权力
